speech:
Alright, Grizzly Rips, pull up a chair. Today's a C-, and I'm not gonna dress that up in a Sunday suit. 4 matches, 1 win, 3 losses. We scored 10 and let in 14. That's 3.5 goals against every single match, and when you're leaking like a screen door on a submarine, it doesn't much matter how many you score. We took zero points from first halves all day, and the other side out-rated us 8.33 to 7.86. Our usual is about 1.5 points a match; today we managed less than 1.

Now the ladder. We woke up in Division 4, 1 win away from promotion. We got that win, 5-4 over Blitz FC, and we're in Division 3. That's real, and I'm proud of it. Then we lost to Real Day Shift 0-3 and finished the night in Division 3 with 0 of 12 points, needing 12 to move up again. We climbed the ladder and then just sorta stood there blinking at the view.

PhogsToffees, you were the engine today. 5 goals, 5 assists, and a perfect 10.0 against Blitz FC, your 9th perfect match for us. That's beautiful. But that last match? A 6.4, zero shots on target, and 8 misplaced passes. You tried to do it all yourself with 38 pass attempts, and it got loose. And defensively, you won 2 tackles out of 11. That's 18% against your usual 32%. Forwards defend too, friend.

buddskees, I've gotta say it plain: you quit the Los Cottageros match while we were down 3-4. One goal. You left your teammates short with a match still breathing. That one stings. Then against Real Day Shift you converted none of your shots and missed 2 tackles. Your tackling dropped to 57% from your usual 68%. But match 3, you were electric: 7 shots and 88% passing in the match that got us promoted. That's who you are when you stick around.

BellyTb1, tough day. You averaged 7.45 against your usual 8.1. Their midfielder posted a 10.0 to your 6.7 against Los Cottageros, which means somebody was running free in your neighborhood. In the last match you missed 4 tackles and put zero shots on target, and overall you won 2 of 9 tackles. But 26 completed passes against ChicagoOvO and 5 shots on target against Blitz FC tell me the quality's right there.

So here's the fix, and it's about effort more than talent. When we lose the ball, the nearest player presses hard for 3 to 5 seconds, and everybody else shuts the passing lanes. Track your runner all the way into the box, because those late, unmarked runs are killing us. And get stuck in. Even winning 1 tackle in 8 pays for the tries.

Here's the thing, y'all. We're 34 wins into this season, we just got promoted, and 4 matches don't erase that. Bad days are just good days that haven't found their footing yet. Tomorrow, we press, we stay, and we show Division 3 we belong. I believe in every one of you.
